risk_if_not_implemented: Without API Gateway, adversaries may move laterally, exfiltrate data or reach systems that should have been isolated from untrusted networks. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), System / Data Compromise (Technical Vector) (R-BC-4), System / Service Compromise (R-EX-7), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Human Error (MT-9), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Least Privilege
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize the concept of least privilege, allowing only authorized access to processes necessary to accomplish assigned tasks in accordance with organizational business functions.
compensating_control_1.justification: Least Privilege (IAC-30) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of API Gateway (NET-36) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Encrypting Data In Transit
compensating_control_2.description: Cryptographic mechanisms exist to prevent the unauthorized disclosure of data in transit.
compensating_control_2.justification: Encrypting Data In Transit (CRY-05) provides cryptographic protection that compensates for the absence of API Gateway (NET-36) by ensuring data confidentiality and integrity through alternative technical means. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
